newsitem.title: USA: Peak and Moore to merge.
newsitem.headline: Peak and Moore to merge.

text.p: Peak Technologies Group Inc said Wednesday it had entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Moore Corp Ltd in a cash transaction valued at about $210 million.
Moore said it will commence a tender offer for all outstanding Peak shares at $18 each.

Moore said the acquisition will move it forward in its strategy to increase the percentage of its revenues coming from the technology segments of its business, which generate higher margin and growth.
The tender offer is subject to, among other things, the tendering of at least a majority of outstanding Peak shares and the expiration of governmental waiting periods.
